_comment: The values EMRG_START_TIMEOUT is allowed to hold, and what each one means.
Read by BOTH suites, one per entry point: tests/test_daemon_start_diagnostics.py
(the GUI, emrg/gui/daemon_client.js). One list, two readers - the two resolvers are
required to agree on the accept/refuse decision for every value here, and a list kept
separately on each side would be a copy that drifts silently. Issue #1276 item 5,
kind=malformed  refused with a warning in the entry point's own log, falls back to that
entry point's default window (the client 4.5s, the GUI 5.0s)
kind=unset      how a shell spells 'not set'; the default window, and NO warning
The malformed half is the point of the list. `float()` and `Number()` do not accept the
same strings, so 'the two entry points read the same variable' is worth nothing unless
they also agree on what that variable may say: measured on the head of #1404, 7 of 28
values disagreed (`0x10` -> the GUI waited 16s while the client fell back to 4.5s).
